description: Average the points won per death country, with a blank death country kept as its own group. Compare each group's average with the plain average of all group averages, the blank group included.

a.request: For award vote records matched to their players by `player_id` (dropping votes with no matching player), group by the player's death country (`death_country`), keeping players with a blank death country as their own group. For each group, show the death country, the average `points_won` (ignoring missing values), and how far that average is from the simple average of the group averages across all groups, the blank group included. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, '')) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g

b.request: Average `points_won` from `player_award_vote` (ignoring NULL points) for each `death_country` of the matched `player`, with players whose death country is blank/NULL kept as their own group, then show each group's average and its difference from the plain unweighted mean of all the per-country averages (blank group included), unrounded
b.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM g ORDER BY death_country

c.request: For players who received award votes (matched to `player` by `player_id`), what is the average `points_won` for each death country (ignoring missing points)? Show each death country, its average, and how far it is from the simple average of those per-country averages, without rounding. Average the points won per death country, with a blank death country kept as its own group. Compare each group's average with the plain average of all group averages, the blank group included.
c.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM g

d.request: For players who received award votes (matched to `player` by `player_id`), what is the average `points_won` for each death country, ignoring missing points and keeping players with a blank death country as their own group? Show each death country, its average, and how far it is from the simple average of all the per-country averages (including the blank group), without rounding.
d.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, '')) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c
